**Fix Applied:**

```java
public void updateInterface(Interface discoveredInterface) {
  Interface existing = repository.findById(discoveredInterface.getId());
  if (existing != null) {
    // Preserve manually configured speed if different from discovered
    if (existing.isSpeedManuallyConfigured() && 
        !existing.getSpeed().equals(discoveredInterface.getSpeed())) {
      // Keep the configured speed, don't overwrite
      discoveredInterface.setSpeed(existing.getSpeed());
    }
    existing.setSpeed(discoveredInterface.getSpeed());
    existing.setStatus(discoveredInterface.getStatus());
    repository.save(existing);
  }
}
```

Added `testConfiguredInterfaceSpeedPersist()` test to verify manually configured speeds persist during rediscovery.

```java
public Set<Protocol> getDefaultProtocols(Set<LinkLayer> linkLayers) {
    Set<Protocol> defaults = new HashSet<>();
    if (linkLayers.contains(LinkLayer.L2)) {
        defaults.addAll(Arrays.asList(Protocol.CDP, Protocol.LLDP));
    }
    if (linkLayers.contains(LinkLayer.L3)) {
        defaults.add(Protocol.SPM);
    }
    return defaults;
}
```

```java
public String calculateMD5(String filename) {
    try {
        MessageDigest md = MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5");
        FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(filename);
        byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
        int bytesRead;
        while ((bytesRead = fis.read(buffer)) != -1) {
            md.update(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
        }
        return DatatypeConverter.printHexBinary(md.digest());
    } catch (Exception e) {
        throw new RuntimeException("MD5 calculation failed", e);
    }
}
```

I can see the issue. The SNMP bulk request fails entirely when one OID (`.1.3.6.1.6.3.10.2.1.3.0`) throws an authorization error on Netgear devices.

**Solution:** Implement individual OID fallback in `DeviceConfigPoller.PollMetrics()`:

```go
func (p *DeviceConfigPoller) PollMetrics(device *Device) error {
    oids := []string{
        ".1.3.6.1.2.1.1.1.0", ".1.3.6.1.2.1.1.2.0",
        ".1.3.6.1.6.3.10.2.1.3.0", ".1.3.6.1.2.1.1.3.0",
        ".1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5.0", ".1.3.6.1.2.1.1.6.0",
    }
    
    // Try bulk request first
    result, err := p.snmpClient.GetBulk(oids)
    if err != nil {
        // Fallback: try individual OIDs
        result = make(map[string]interface{})
        for _, oid := range oids {
            if val, ierr := p.snmpClient.Get(oid); ierr == nil {
                result[oid] = val
            }
        }
    }
    return p.processResults(result)
}
```

This ensures other OIDs are collected even if the problematic StartedTimeSeconds OID fails on Netgear devices.

```java
public class PatchLoader {
    public List<Class<?>> loadPatchClasses() {
        try {
            return ClassPath.from(Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader())
                .getTopLevelClasses("com.mindarray.patch")
                .stream()
                .map(ClassPath.ClassInfo::load)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new PatchLoadingException("Failed to scan patch package", e);
        }
    }
}
```

This approach scans the classpath for .class files instead of using reflection, avoiding the server class loading issues.

```java
public void updatePollingTime(List<String> groupIds, int newPollingTime) {

}
```

```java
  emailBuffer.append("device:").append(profile.getDevice());

  sendEmail(emailContent);
}
```

```java
public void bulkAssignTags(List<String> agentIds, List<String> tags) {
    List<Agent> agents = agentRepository.findByIdIn(agentIds);
    for (Agent agent : agents) {
        if (!agent.isHealthAgent()) {  // Skip health agents
            agent.getTags().addAll(tags);
            agentRepository.save(agent);
        }
    }
}

public void bulkAssignGroups(List<String> agentIds, List<String> groups) {
    List<Agent> agents = agentRepository.findByIdIn(agentIds);
    for (Agent agent : agents) {
        if (!agent.isHealthAgent()) {  // Skip health agents
            agent.getGroups().addAll(groups);
            agentRepository.save(agent);
        }
    }
}
```

This ensures health agents are excluded from bulk tag/group assignments.

```java
private final Set<String> pendingRegistrations = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
```

I've identified the performance bottleneck in NetRoutePolicyInspector.inspectPolicy(). The issue:

**Problem:** O(n²) insertion sort runs on every single event insertion in a high-frequency method (1000+ calls/sec).

**Solution:**
1. Replace insertionSort() with quickSort() implementation
2. Add a 'dirty' flag to only sort when data is accessed
3. Sort lazily in getter methods instead of on every insertion

**Implementation:**
```java
private boolean needsSort = false;

public void inspectPolicy(PolicyEvent event) {
  events.add(event);
  needsSort = true; // Mark as dirty instead of sorting
}

public List<PolicyEvent> getSortedEvents() {
  if (needsSort) {
    quickSort(events, 0, events.size() - 1);
    needsSort = false;
  }
  return events;
}
```

This changes complexity from O(n²) per insertion to O(n log n) when actually needed.

```java
public boolean pingDevice(String ip) {
    try {

    }
}
```
